remarks: Exceptional value in a prime location on the Stamford/Old Greenwich border! Welcome to the Palmer Hill Complex. This beautiful 2-bedroom, 2-full bath condo offers the perfect blend of elegance and comfort. Step inside to find hardwood floors, high ceilings, dining/living room open concept layout and a cozy gas fireplace in the living room. The kitchen has stainless steel appliances, marble countertops, and a breakfast bar that flows into the dining and living areas ideal for both entertaining and everyday living. Enjoy your own private balcony for morning coffee or evening relaxation. The primary suite includes a walk-in closet and a full bathroom, whirlpool/shower with double vanities and direct access to the balcony. Turnkey condo. Dog friendly!
